record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change maximum observed-history length from 128 to 32 in training and inference. Most histories fit within this window; removing older interactions from long histories may reduce stale-interest interference without the state averaging that previously regressed. Preserve final-real-position readout, embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer. Save the updated history length for the predictor.
